text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The racecourse is abuzz with excitement
about
the showdown between Silence
Suzuka, the
Otherworldly Front-Runner,
and Эйр Грув, the
Empress.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two exchange few words as they
approach
their challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
